tables.comment: Per-cycle audit snapshot of the IB account (cash, margin, gross/net liq). Append-only ; written by execution-engine on each account-summary update.
tables.name: account_history

tables.comment: Audit log of every successful Submit — captures the full book state right after the new trade is open. Append-only.
tables.name: book_state_snapshot_history

tables.comment: User-level trades booked into the book (1 row per Submit). Append-only ; lifecycle states tracked via state column.
tables.name: booked_position

check_constraints.name: ck_signal_track_status
check_constraints.sql: signal_status IS NULL OR signal_status IN ('HOLD','TRIM','EXIT')

tables.comment: Per-cycle greeks + P&L snapshot per booked_position row. Append-only ; written by risk-engine every cycle.
tables.name: booked_position_metric_history

tables.comment: Versioned set of systematic exit rules (z-flip / time / stop-loss / DTE thresholds). Append-only ; latest row is the source of truth.
tables.name: config_exit_rules

tables.comment: Generic scalar key/value config — namespace='risk' for trade-gating limits, namespace='delta_hedge' for the hedger loop. UPDATE-in-place.
tables.name: config_scalar

tables.comment: Versioned full vol-engine config (Pydantic JSON blob). Append-only ; engines hot-reload via Redis pub/sub on insert.
tables.name: config_vol_engine

tables.comment: Catalogue of economic events scraped from FRED / ECB / BoE / FOMC / Eurostat / ONS. Idempotent UPSERT keyed by event_hash.
tables.name: event_calendar

check_constraints.name: ck_exit_alerts_exec_status
check_constraints.sql: execution_status IS NULL OR execution_status IN ('in_progress','done','failed','overridden')

tables.comment: Triggered exit alerts pending operator review. Append-only ; consumed by the exit-alert panel.
tables.name: exit_alert

tables.comment: Wide-format timeseries of derived vol features (ATM IV per tenor, rv_yz, vol_of_vol, term_slope, z-scores). Append-only.
tables.name: feature_history

tables.comment: EUR FUT delta-hedge orders submitted by the delta-hedger loop. Append-only ; one row per fire.
tables.name: hedge_order

tables.comment: Live IB-side positions reconciled against ib_insync. UPDATE-in-place by position-sync (5 s cadence) ; row deleted when fully closed.
tables.name: open_position

tables.comment: Per-cycle greeks + P&L snapshot per open_position row. Append-only ; written by risk-engine every cycle.
tables.name: open_position_history

tables.comment: Murex-style operational grouping of multiple trade_structure rows. Populated by manual API call ; FK target of trade_structure.package_id.
tables.name: package

tables.comment: Versioned PCA fit (means / stds / loadings / eigenvalues as JSONB). Append-only ; is_active=true marks the live model.
tables.name: pca_model

tables.comment: One row per (PC, cycle) — z-score, label (CHEAP/FAIR/EXPENSIVE), actionable flag, recommended structure. Append-only.
tables.name: pca_signal_history

tables.comment: 30-dimensional hourly snapshot of the vol surface (6 tenors x 5 deltas). The PCA fit input. Append-only.
tables.name: pca_surface_snapshot_history

tables.comment: One row per vol-engine cycle — regime label, the features that drove the classification, GMM probas, event_dampener. Append-only.
tables.name: regime_snapshot_history

check_constraints.name: ck_ib_connection_account_type
check_constraints.sql: account_type IS NULL OR account_type IN ('paper','live')

tables.comment: Singleton row tracking the IB session state — heartbeat, account type (paper/live), cash + margin. UPDATE-in-place every ~10 s.
tables.name: runtime_ib_session

tables.comment: Audit log of every order action (submit, cancel, fill, reject) tied to a trade_structure row. Append-only ; replaces the legacy execution_audit_log.
tables.name: trade_event

tables.comment: Per-leg fill confirmations from IB. Append-only ; one row per fill, linked to trade_order.id.
tables.name: trade_fill

tables.comment: Active IB orders submitted as part of a trade_structure. UPDATE-in-place on status transitions ; long-lived for audit.
tables.name: trade_order

tables.comment: Audit log : one row per Arm click on the UI. Tracks the (signal, structure, state) tuple for 90 s — either Submit promotes it to a trade_structure or it expires.
tables.name: trade_preview

tables.comment: Root of the Murex package > trade > contract hierarchy. One row per user-confirmed Submit ; lifecycle tracked via state column.
tables.name: trade_structure

tables.comment: Per-cycle full vol surface fit (SVI/SSVI params + ATM per tenor) stored as JSONB. Append-only ; written by vol-engine each cycle.
tables.name: vol_surface_history
